sqlpipe v2.0 Release Notes

Breaking Change: User Name Fields

The /v2/users endpoint no longer returns the `name` field. The field is now two fields: `first_name` and `last_name`. You must update your code before you install this version. Clients that read the `name` field will fail.

New Feature: Incremental Mode

The `--incremental` flag is new. Use this flag to copy only the rows that changed since the last run. This flag decreases the load on the source database.

Performance: Faster Parquet Writes

Parquet writes are 40% faster than in v1. You do not need to change your configuration to get this speed. The change applies to all Parquet targets.

Upgrade Steps

1. Update your client code for the new name fields.
2. Install sqlpipe v2.0.
3. Test your pipelines.
